content.description: Heist On Alpha is an ongoing comic and collectables NFT series on Cardano. The story revolves around a team of thieves known as 'Shifters', who travel to alternate versions of Earth to steal wealth and technology. Besides the main story chapters that release every few months, there are special event drops to raise funds for charity, and various other releases such as exclusive character and PFP based art.
